_note: The collector cards of 2026-09-28 (owner: the small circles were unattractive and hard to read). Each collection's card: a cut-out of the jersey in the image (scripts/images/cutout.py; white jerseys cut with --thresh 4, the Juventus and Ja Morant photos with --bg auto), a color and a mark, stored in the collection metafields sportwear.card_image / card_color / card_mark (catalog/metafields.json). To change a card, edit those three fields on the collection in admin, or override them in the theme editor on the section's block.

_note_2026_10_04: Every other team page got a card on 2026-10-04 (the owner chose 'a colour and a card for every team'): 136 collections, each from the first jersey of the team's page (a few swapped for the team's best-known shirt: France navy home, Inter Miami pink home, the Raiders black and the Bears navy). Cut with scripts/images/recut-card.py: 'auto' for coloured studio renders (removes their grey shadow rim), 'flood' for white and white-striped jerseys, 'grey' for the three photos on a grey backdrop (Memphis, Utah, Houston); 900 px PNGs. The colour and the mark are set per team (the mark is the team's usual short code). The NFL team pages show their card on the night-field banner, which is set on the nfl, nfl-jerseys and nfl-jerseys-kids collections. The four NFL teams with no jersey yet (Saints, Buccaneers, Titans, Commanders) have no card until their jerseys come.
